title: Runtime D: Anthropic's Claude through the Airline Connector
lede: Claude reaches the same Airline Connector as Meta's Muse (runtime B). What differs: who adds it, how it gets a client ID, which PingOne app signs Sam in, and who calls /mcp. Not tried yet: Claude's PingOne app is not in MUSE_CONNECTOR_AGENTS on SE yet.

lanes.label: D. Anthropic's Claude: the company adds the connector once, Sam just connects

steps.title: Ready to use
steps.what: The company has already added the connector: Owner: Organization settings > Connectors > Add > Custom > Web, URL {{origin}}/mcp; or a listing in the Connectors Directory.
steps.why: Members then only click Connect. Nobody types a URL or client ID.

steps.title: Ask
steps.what: Sam asks Claude: "How many airline points do I have?".

steps.title: Call, no token
steps.what: Claude picks loyalty_balance from the Airline Connector and calls /mcp. It has no token yet.
steps.why: The model chooses from the tool names and descriptions. The airline's name in them is what steers it.

steps.title: 401, sign in
steps.what: /mcp answers 401 with metadata: sign in at /connector/authorize, PKCE S256, scope mcp.
steps.why: Claude learns where to sign in from the server, not from config.

steps.title: Authorize
steps.what: Claude registers itself at /connector/register, then sends Sam to /connector/authorize. Muse starts the PingOne sign-in with the "Claude agent login" PingOne app, chosen because the callback host is claude.ai.
steps.why: claude.ai is a listed agent host (MUSE_CONNECTOR_AGENTS), so it may register. Muse issues a public client (no secret). The Owner can paste a client ID in Advanced settings instead.

steps.title: Protect check
steps.what: PingOne runs the DaVinci flow: password, Protect risk, MFA on medium risk. Protect sees the "Claude agent login" PingOne app and names Claude.
steps.why: The agent is recognised by PingOne, not by its own word. The screen must say how it knows. Protect's museAgentClient predictor already lists that app (HIGH).

steps.title: Consent
steps.what: PingOne shows the "AI agent detected" screen, then asks Sam to let Claude act for him. Sam agrees.
steps.why: No consent, no token: a "no" ends the flow with nothing issued.

steps.title: Exchanges, token
steps.what: Muse does the code swap and both exchanges with the "Claude agent login" PingOne app, then gives Claude its own access token at /connector/token.
steps.why: So act names Claude. The PingOne token never leaves Muse. Claude holds only a Muse token for scope mcp.

steps.title: Call with token
steps.what: Anthropic's servers call /mcp with that token. Muse calls the gateway, which checks the delegated token, and the points come back.
steps.why: Not tried yet: Claude's PingOne app is not in MUSE_CONNECTOR_AGENTS on SE yet.
